## GameSettings component
- **Status:** Required
- **Type:** Constant Binding `Injects.GameSettings`

### Description
Represents the games settings as sent by the server in `responseData.GameSettings`. Made up of any data that doesn't change after a successful resume such as Engine Version or RTP values.

Has no implementation within the package so is required to be implemented by the game project.

Should implement the interface `IBaseGameSettingsModel`

### API

#### engineVersion: string
string representation of the server version for this game, found in `responseData.GameSettings.Version`.

#### rtp: string
string representation of the games Return To layer as a %.

Will be displayed in the How To Play and Game Rules Vues.

#### setData(responseData: IBaseServerResponse): void
Should update the model data with new values from the ServerResponse.

Internally called during bootstrap on a successful *Resume* request.

Typically doesn't need to be called more than once.

### BareBones Example
```ts
// file game-settings.ts

import { IBaseGameSettingsModel, IBaseServerResponse } from '@arcade-client/base-package';

export class GameSettings implements IBaseGameSettingsModel {
    public static get Instance(): GameSettings { return this._instance || (this._instance = new GameSettings()); }
    private static _instance: GameSettings;

    public engineVersion: string = '';
    public rtp: string = '';

    private constructor() { }

    public setData(responseData: IBaseServerResponse): void {
        this.engineVersion = responseData.GameSettings.Version;
        this.rtp = responseData.GameSettings.RTP ? responseData.GameSettings.RTP : '98.25';
    }
}

export const gameSettings = GameSettings.Instance;
```
